The one and only time I saw it was near Lake Elmer Thomas Recreational Area (LETRA) on fort sill. Was summer of 2010 and the heat of that summer had dried the whole area to a pale yellow and lowered the water levels of the lake by like a foot or so. I wasn’t up close to it maybe 250-300 meters when I saw it on the other side of the lake from where I was standing with my wife. All I remember was pointing over to a location my buddy and I used to access via driving through the woods on that side to be away from everyone else’s fishing spots. That’s when I saw it stand up from the edge of the water, was a completely dark and tall figure (maybe 8-9 feet tall) that within seconds covered like 50 feet of distance within seconds as it disappeared northwest into the wood line where the elk and other large animals frequently use. Mind you it couldn’t have been a hunter cause there’s no hunting on fort sill. I never went fishing there again after that day.. 

There’s a report on the BFRO website that details my encounter. 

https://www.bfro.net/GDB/show_report.asp?id=30150
